Asset Host capabilities are exactly asset.read, create, update, delete, and restore.

Render requires template.render.
Same-scope copy requires template.read on the source and template.create on the target scope.

Only a caller with template.render may receive successful RenderOutput.
template.render alone reveals no DesignDSL, revision history, child Template, or Asset detail.
LayoutTrace requests require both template.render and render.trace.
Only trace segments whose Template is readable by the caller can project author locators from sidecar.

render.trace grants no Template or Asset read, Render, edit, or Engine access.
Asset directory, detail, version, download, and draft resource selection require asset.read.
Asset create requires asset.create.
Asset metadata or content update requires asset.update.
Asset deletion requires asset.delete.
Asset lifecycle restore requires asset.restore.

After root Template render authorization, authored same-scope Template and Asset resolution uses internal capability without inheriting caller read per item.
Host capabilities do not imply one another.
Cross-scope ID access or lack of both operation and corresponding read returns namespaced NOT_FOUND.
A caller with corresponding read but lacking mutation, render, or trace receives namespaced FORBIDDEN.
A caller with an operation capability but without read may execute that authorized operation.
An operation-only response removes author content, revision, child, Asset, and other read-only facts from responses, problems, and sidecar projection.
Authorization drift before confirmation, queue admission, or execution makes every not-yet-completed action zero-write or zero-output under latest authorization.
An atomically completed Template or Asset mutation is not rolled back after authorization drift.
An unknown mutation result enters the existing reconciliation flow.
Render or trace authorization loss before atomic output seal discards the complete result.
After seal, transport can replay only the already-authorized sealed response and cannot expand diagnostics.

v1 has no small or large, preview or production, or interactive or batch capacity tiers.
Each limit belongs to the exact wire or Profile that owns its semantics.
Every effective budget enters the Evaluation fingerprint.

Queueing cannot renew the request deadline.

The reference Engine instance has four FIFO queue positions.
